name: Hero Realms
summary: A fantasy deck-building dueling game where players buy champions and actions from a shared market to reduce opponents to zero health.
rules_text: Each player starts with 50 health and a 10-card deck (7 Gold, Ruby, Shortsword, Dagger). Shuffle your deck. First player draws 3, second draws 5. Setup: shuffle Market Deck, reveal 5 cards as Market, place Fire Gems pile beside it. On your turn you have Main, Discard, Draw phases. In Main, play any cards from hand at no cost to gain gold, combat, health, and effects. Gold goes to a pool to buy one Market card at a time, put it in discard, replace it from Market Deck. Combat goes to a pool to attack. Damage can hit opponent's prepared Guard champions first; you must stun guards before hitting player or other champions. Champions stay in play with defense value, start prepared (upright). To use their expend power turn them sideways. Ally bonus triggers if another card of same faction is in play. Sacrifice ability sends card to sacrifice pile for extra effect. Unspent pools are lost at end of Main. Discard all Actions/Items, keep champions, prepare expended champions. Draw 5. Last player with health remaining wins.
rating_reason: Deckbuilding card game with hidden hands and drafting fits engine
